title: Elevator Service Work Order Form
subtitle: Elevator Service: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Elevator Service Work Order Form covers elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing. The building elevator coordinator records Elevator Service authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Elevator Service Work Order Form keeps Elevator Service exceptions visible until the building elevator coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Elevator Service Work Order Form at machine space, hoistway access point, car, and affected landings. Document elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing identity before Elevator Service begins. Compare elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing findings with stated Elevator Service criteria; route unresolved Elevator Service issues to licensed or otherwise qualified elevator service reviewer. For Elevator Service Work Order Form, confirm requirements for Elevator Service. Ask licensed or otherwise qualified elevator service reviewer to review Elevator Service conditions beyond the building elevator coordinator's role.
